Fertilizer.title: Fertilizer Recommendation
Fertilizer.subtitle: Enter your field and soil-test details to get a source-linked nutrient plan where verified local guidance is available.
Fertilizer.empty: No recommendations saved yet. Submit the form to create your first plan.
Fertilizer.areaNote: Soil test values are optional. Enter laboratory results when available; do not treat nutrient recommendation rates as soil test readings.
Fertilizer.noBundledDose: No bundled ICAR dose is available for {crop} in {state}. You can calculate offline using the exact N, P₂O₅ and K₂O rates from this field’s Soil Health Card or KVK recommendation.
Fertilizer.selectStateCropRates: Select any state and crop, then enter the rates from the field’s Soil Health Card or KVK recommendation.
Fertilizer.quantityOnly: This mode calculates product quantities; it does not invent a crop dose.
Fertilizer.cropRateN: From your crop recommendation · kg N/ha
Fertilizer.enterP2O5: Enter P₂O₅, not elemental P · kg/ha
Fertilizer.enterK2O: Enter K₂O, not elemental K · kg/ha
Fertilizer.remainingShareScheduled: Remaining nutrient share is scheduled here.
Fertilizer.enterRatesCalculate: Enter the recommended nutrient rates above, then calculate to see product quantities.

Irrigation.title: Smart Irrigation Planner
Irrigation.subtitle: Estimate crop water demand, save a soil-check reminder, and keep watering history.
Irrigation.addCycle: Add a farm field and crop cycle to plan irrigation.
Irrigation.planDescription: Choose the crop, soil, growth stage, and method, then enter measured field capacity, wilting point, current moisture, and effective root depth.
Irrigation.rainfallHint: Context only. Unmeasured rainfall is not credited; record observed rain with runoff and root-zone measurements to include it.
Irrigation.typicalNote: Enter measured field capacity, wilting point, current moisture, and effective root depth. Typical values below are references only and are not used automatically.
Irrigation.currentMoistureHint: Enter a current measured value. This measurement is required to calculate an estimate or save a reminder.
Irrigation.moistureWarning: Measured moisture depletion differs substantially from the days-and-rain estimate. Check the inputs; the measured value is used.
Irrigation.effectiveRainMethod: Effective rain = 0.8 × rain for daily amounts ≥ 5 mm; otherwise 0.
Irrigation.calculationLimits: Calculation limits and offline reference sources
Irrigation.historicalLimit: Offline ETo values are historical district climate normals, not live weather.
Irrigation.rainLimit: Rainfall entered or uploaded is treated as actual farmer-provided data; the planner does not verify it. CSV rainfall is calculated day by day.
Irrigation.typicalLimit: Soil values are typical range midpoints; override them with field measurements when available. Crop root depth is the FAO-56 scheduling reference, not a sensor reading.
Irrigation.riceLimit: Rice/paddy water dose is withheld because ponding, seepage, and percolation are not modeled.
Irrigation.monthlyEmpty: Monthly totals will appear after watering is recorded.
Irrigation.cycleUnchanged: Crop cycle is kept unchanged for this transaction.
Irrigation.addCycleToRecord: Add a crop cycle before recording watering.
Irrigation.rainDescription: Enter a manual observation, a weather-station reading, or a forecast. Manual and station values are farmer-entered reports, not verified station API observations. Forecasts are scenarios and are never deducted as observed rainfall.
Irrigation.runoffZeroHint: Enter 0 only if rainfall fully infiltrated without runoff.
Irrigation.rainfallMethodHelp: Effective rain = rainfall − measured runoff/non-infiltrated loss, capped by measured root-zone storage to field capacity. Overflow is drainage. Rain on or before the moisture reading is excluded to avoid double-counting.
Irrigation.noRainRecords: No rainfall observations or forecast scenarios recorded.
Irrigation.historySubtitle: Completed watering transactions and planned soil checks are shown separately.
Irrigation.actualWatering: Actual water applied. Multiple events on the same date are retained.
Irrigation.reminderOnly: Reminder dates only; no water amount is implied.
Irrigation.deleteConfirm: Delete this watering record? This cannot be undone.
Irrigation.recordDeleted: Watering record deleted. The totals and reports have been refreshed.
Irrigation.recordDuplicate: This watering record was already saved; no duplicate was added.
Irrigation.rainDuplicate: This rainfall entry was already saved; no duplicate was added.
Irrigation.rainUnavailable: Effective rainfall is unavailable and no deduction will be applied.
Irrigation.rainNoCycle: Add a crop cycle before recording rainfall.
Irrigation.rainEstimatedLosses: Estimated from measured losses and storage
Irrigation.rainNotCreditedMoisture: Not credited: may already be in soil reading
Irrigation.confirmDelete: Delete this watering record? This cannot be undone.
Irrigation.wateringDuplicate: This watering record was already saved; no duplicate was added.
Irrigation.rainDuplicateMsg: This rainfall entry was already saved; no duplicate was added.
Irrigation.effectiveUnavailableMsg: Effective rainfall is unavailable and no deduction will be applied.
Irrigation.rainDeleted: Watering record deleted. The totals and reports have been refreshed.
Irrigation.offlineEtoHint: Uses the bundled historical ETo normal for this district and month. Works offline.
Irrigation.onlineEtoHint: Fetches current-day model ETo online. If unavailable, the estimate stays unavailable; the offline dataset is not substituted.
Irrigation.onlineEtoUnavailable: Live ETo could not be retrieved. Select the offline dataset or try again later.
Irrigation.openMeteoCurrentDay: Open-Meteo daily model for the selected date (not station-observed)
Irrigation.forecastNotDeducted: Forecast is shown for context only and is not used as observed rainfall.
Irrigation.calculationDateHint: Choose the date for this irrigation estimate. It cannot be earlier than today.
Irrigation.moistureMeasuredDateHint: Select when the field moisture reading was taken. This date is shared by planning and rainfall credit.
Irrigation.rainMoistureDateHint: Rain can only be credited when dated after the soil moisture reading. Estimating effective rain also requires runoff, field capacity, current moisture, and root depth from the planner inputs.
Irrigation.rainWillNotBeCredited: This rainfall will not be credited: it may already be reflected in the soil moisture reading.
Irrigation.rainEffectiveMissingMeasurements: Effective rainfall cannot be estimated until runoff, field capacity, current moisture, and root depth are available. Gross rainfall can still be saved.

CropCalendar.title: Smart Crop Calendar
CropCalendar.subtitle: Plan crop activities from saved Crop Management records.
CropCalendar.hero: Know what’s next in the field, from sowing to harvest.
CropCalendar.chooseCycle: Choose one of your saved crop cycles. Field details and dates come from Crop Management.
CropCalendar.milletRequired: Required for the configured duration reference
CropCalendar.emptyTitle: Your crop calendar will appear here
CropCalendar.emptyText: Generate a plan to see upcoming farm activities, harvest estimates and weather updates together.
CropCalendar.automaticDates: Dates and field details are sourced from Crop Management. Change them there; pending tasks update automatically.
CropCalendar.noCycles: No crop cycles are ready for planning yet.
CropCalendar.deleteConfirm: Delete the generated calendar? Crop cycle and farm records will remain.
CropCalendar.calendarDeleted: Generated calendar deleted. Your crop cycle and farm records are unchanged.
CropCalendar.calendarRefreshed: Calendar refreshed. Completed activities were preserved and pending activities recalculated.
CropCalendar.refreshHint: Generate or refresh the plan to add its schedule.
